title: 连接 Video Transcriber
description: 在 Video Transcriber API 控制台创建 Key，并粘贴到此处。转写使用独立 API 额度；网站会员积分不适用。凭证由 WorkBuddy 保存在本机。
description_en: Create a Key in the Video Transcriber API console and paste it here. Transcription uses independent API Quota, not website credits. WorkBuddy stores the credential locally.
